events.title: 아스널 move closer to their second double by beating 울버햄프턴 원더러스 1–0 in the FA Cup semi-final at Villa Park .

뉴캐슬 유나이티드, who have had a dismal season in the Premier League, are given the hope of FA Cup glory after a semi-final win over 셰필드 유나이티드 at Old Trafford sends them into the FA Cup final for the first time since 1974.
노팅엄 포리스트 go six points clear of third-placed 선덜랜드 in the First Division with a win at home to Reading. 선덜랜드 have two matches remaining.
선덜랜드 are beaten, confirming 노팅엄 포리스트's promotion back to the Premier League.
An incident in a 0–0 draw between 레스터 시티 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 lead to Alan Shearer being investigated by the Football Association, after he appeared to deliberately kick Neil Lennon in the head.

April draws to a close with 아스널 now leading by a point ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 and having two games in hand, as United manager 알렉스 퍼거슨 concedes the title despite his team's 3–0 win over 크리스털 팰리스, whose relegation is confirmed. Meanwhile, 애스턴 빌라 have emerged as surprise contenders for a UEFA Cup place after spending most of the season battling relegation, and there will also be a UEFA Cup place for the seventh-placed club if 아스널 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the FA Cup final next month. At the other end of the table, 반즐리 and 볼턴 원더러스 remain in the bottom three, but there is still a threat of relegation for 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 에버턴 as well as a 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 side who came close to winning the title last season and the season before. 윔블던, who only need two points from their final three games to achieve safety, are the only other team under threat of relegation. 노팅엄 포리스트 have sealed an immediate return to the top flight as Division One champions, while 미들즈브러, 선덜랜드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 are still fighting it out for second place. 셰필드 유나이티드 and 버밍엄 시티 are challenging each other for the final playoff place.
